title: Fourier tail weight bound above level $k$
statement:
Let $f : \{0,1\}^n \to \bbr$ be a Boolean function, and let $k$ be a positive integer. Then the total Fourier weight of $f$ carried by frequencies of size strictly greater than $k$ is bounded by the total influence divided by $k$:
\[
  \sum_{\substack{S \subseteq [n] \\ \abs{S} > k}} \hat f(S)^2 \;\le\; \frac{I[f]}{k}.
\]
hypotheses_covered: f is a Boolean function of arity n
k is a natural number with 0 < k
replaced:
For $k > 0$ the Fourier weight of $f$ above level $k$ is controlled by the total
influence:
\[
  \sum_{\abs{S} > k} \hat f(S)^2 \;\le\; \frac{I[f]}{k}.
\]
